messages:
Alex G.: hey team — i'm Alex (backend), started today. quick q: who owns badge provisioning for cross-team folks? I need infra repo + oncall access.
Maria K.: welcome! For physical badge ping @facilities or email facilities@redwood.com. For infra repo access open an access request via the infra-access portal (link in handbook).
Carla S.: Hi Alex — i'll handle badge. DM me your employee ID and preferred pickup window.
InfraBot: Access request created: REQ-4719. Status: pending approvals.
Jon P.: Oncall ownership: platform-oncall owns runtime services, eng-sre owns infra. Team-level owners are in the ownership matrix (Confluence) — quick link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ownership
Samir R.: If you need to find a service owner locally, use the repo-tools helper: `./who_owns <service-name>` — it prints owner @mentions and oncall.
Alex G.: thanks — if production latency spikes what's the escalation path?
Maria K.: Primary: check alerts -> ping platform-oncall -> if no response in 15m escalate to eng-sre manager (cc Carla S.). If customer-impacting, page the oncall immediately.
Carla S.: Also open a PagerDuty incident and attach the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/latency-troubleshoot. Include metrics snapshot and recent deploys.
HR-Bot: Reminder: New hire checklist pending: ID verification, 2FA setup, sign NDA. Please complete within 48 hours.
Alex G.: 2FA done, ID verification uploaded today.
Maria K.: Want to do a 15-min intro + owners map at 2pm today to run through who to ping for which services?
Jon P.: I'll join for the runtime/latency lanes.
Samir R.: I can demo the owner script too.
Carla S.: I'll add the calendar invite and include the infra-access link and PagerDuty team names.
Alex G.: Awesome — really appreciate the quick help. :tada:
